_note: Sample of real clubs and societies from the public Imperial College Union A to Z listing (imperialcollegeunion.org), fetched on 2026-11-14. Descriptions are short summaries in our own words of each society's public page; topic tags are our own judgement (a society with no matching taxonomy topic has none, so it can only appear as a wildcard). Not an official or complete list.

societies.name: Racing (Imperial Racing Green)
societies.description: Student team that designs and builds cars for the Shell Eco-Marathon energy-efficiency competition and Formula Student.

societies.name: Robotics
societies.description: Imperial's robotics and making society, with its own lab of 3D printers, a laser cutter and soldering stations for members' prototypes and builds.

societies.name: Space Society
societies.description: Runs space engineering projects such as CubeSats, rocket engines and rocketry competitions, and teaches beginners from scratch.

societies.name: Autonomous Underwater Vehicle (AUV)
societies.description: Team that designs, builds and tests autonomous underwater robots, combining mechanical design, electronics, embedded software and control.

societies.name: Aeronautics (AeroSoc)
societies.description: Community for aeronautics students and other aerospace enthusiasts, running talks, trips and social events.

societies.name: Mechanical Engineering (MechSoc)
societies.description: The department society every Mechanical Engineering student belongs to, running socials and professional talks with engineering, finance and consulting partners.

societies.name: DoCSoc
societies.description: One of Imperial's largest societies, for anyone into computing and technology, with tech talks from industry and plenty of socials.

societies.name: Prototyping and Hacking Society (ProtoSoc)
societies.description: Home for makers and builders who prototype and hack on everyday or global problems, run hackspace workshops and lead a RoboCup team.

societies.name: MedTech
societies.description: Collaborative platform for medical technology innovation open to medical and non-medical students, with speaker and workshop series.

societies.name: Prosthetics
societies.description: Project teams building a bionic arm, an exoskeleton, prosthetic knee and ankle designs and an affordable prosthesis adapter, with CAD, electronics and 3D-printing workshops.

societies.name: Entrepreneurs
societies.description: Imperial's society for founders and would-be founders, offering networks, mentoring and opportunities to turn ideas into companies.

societies.name: Consultancy
societies.description: The student society for anyone curious about consulting or planning a consultancy career.

societies.name: Finance
societies.description: A large careers-focused society for students aiming at jobs in finance.

societies.name: Algorithmic Trading (AlgoSoc)
societies.description: Teaches members about trading and financial markets, from the basics to quantitative and algorithmic trading.

societies.name: Venture Capital & Private Equity
societies.description: Lectures, workshops, career panels and networking about venture capital and private equity investing.

societies.name: Energy
societies.description: Open to anyone interested in the energy sector, helping members build the insight, skills and network for energy careers.

societies.name: Engineers Without Borders UK
societies.description: Part of a global movement that wants engineering practised for people and planet rather than mainly for profit.

societies.name: Climate Entrepreneurs
societies.description: Helps entrepreneurial students build ventures that tackle climate change and related UN Sustainable Development Goals.

societies.name: Mathematics (MathSoc)
societies.description: Imperial's main maths society, open to all STEM students, mixing talks and learning with socials.

societies.name: Physics (PhySoc)
societies.description: Free talks, conferences, careers events, competitions and socials for anyone who studies or enjoys physics.

societies.name: Debating
societies.description: Free weekly debating sessions for everyone, from experienced debaters to people new to public speaking.

societies.name: PhotoSoc
societies.description: Guidance and facilities for students who want to grow as photographers and meet others who share the hobby.

societies.name: Art Club
societies.description: Arts-and-crafts and life-drawing workshops, an art studio, socials and an annual exhibition.

societies.name: Big Band
societies.description: Jazz big band of scientists, engineers and medics that plays across the London and UK university scene.

societies.name: Philosophy
societies.description: Weekly discussions on any philosophical question, from the nature of reality to the ethics of artificial intelligence.

societies.name: Japan
societies.description: Free Japanese lessons at every level plus film nights, socials and other events through the year.

societies.name: French
societies.description: Society for francophone and francophile students that promotes French culture through events.

societies.name: Fellwanderers (Imperial Hiking Society)
societies.description: Imperial's hiking society, with weekly trips that range from countryside walks to mountain tours.

societies.name: Gliding
societies.description: Low-cost flying training in gliders for every level of experience, from first flights to aerobatics.

societies.name: Global Brigades
societies.description: Student-led health and development movement that works with partner communities on sustainable health, economic and education projects.
